C0090.title: Illegal Production and Sale of WeChat Plug-in 'Mini-Tools' Leads to Prison Terms and Fines for Two Individuals
keywords: illegal control of computer information systems
C0090.summary: Zhang and Wang, both company programmers, conspired to download “WeChat robot” source code and develop several WeChat plug-in tools, including mini-program QR-code sharing and keyword-based group joining. They sold the tools online and earned 15,000 yuan. The court convicted both of providing programs or tools for intruding into or illegally controlling computer information systems, sentencing each to nine months in prison and a 5,000 yuan fine.
